title: Erm, What the Sigma?
blurb: Scandalised confusion, delivered by somebody who has spent far too long online. The phrase fuses ironic sigma-male vocabulary with pure Gen Alpha chaos and functions as the designated response to anything even mildly unusual — which is to say almost everything, since the point is the tone rather than the situation. It works sincerely, ironically, and as anthropological commentary on the youth, all of which land. A genuine time capsule of the skibidi era, preserved here in button form for future researchers.
origin: A brainrot catchphrase from the skibidi/sigma meme era.
